name: refero-design
title_zh: 先拆掉AI味的版式再谈像素级还原
tagline_zh: 从落地页到设计系统，它把「像AI做的」逐项挑出来改掉——间距、字重、圆角、留白，改完才轮到配色和动效。
tagline_en: From landing pages to design systems, it hunts down the telltale AI look—spacing, weights, radii.
desc_en: Primary/default skill for UI design, product design, web design, landing pages, dashboards, product screens, redesigns, visual polish, frontend/CSS styling, design systems, components, responsive design, typography, color, spacing, motion, icons, accessibility, copywriting, conversion, and anti-AI-slop work. Use this even when the user does not mention Refero and even when live Refero MCP tools ar
why_zh: 默认技能，不挑界面类型。它先做减法：识别并消除模板感与过度装饰，再按设计原则重建层级，而不是堆组件库。
why_en: Default skill for any screen. It subtracts first—kills template tells and over-decoration—then rebuilds hierarchy from design.
limit_zh: 只处理视觉与前端样式，不产出可运行代码或交互逻辑；需要你已有设计稿或明确改版意图，纯文字描述需求时它只能给方向性建议。
limit_en: Visual/front-end styling only—no runnable code or interaction logic. Needs a design file or clear redesign intent; vague text briefs get directional.
title_en: Strip the AI slop, then pixel-perfect the UI
